$meta.declares: SEL-1 SP4 output-tiling offline-profile measurement cache (C3' capability-keyed pattern library, measurement layer)
$meta.note: The [SEL-1] measurement library: the OFFLINE-PROFILE cache the capability-keyed SP4 (tiled-vs-plain) tiling selector consults BEFORE its cold-start [XFER-1] prior. Each row memoizes the byte-exact-gated timing of ONE (declared_instance_hash, kernel, variant) instance. This is EVIDENCE-axis mirror data (core-invariants I4): it NEVER chooses route/compute/dtype and it is NEVER a correctness or cost authority in `lib/` -- a measured timing is a cache FACT (authority order: hardware measurement > this cache > static prior). The compiler holds an in-memory VIEW of this file (plugin/rvv RVVRepackTilingSelection.h lookupTilingMeasurement) and, on a HIT for (declared_instance_hash, kernel), picks the memoized argmin variant with reason=measured; on a MISS it falls to the [XFER-1] capability prior (reason=prior). SEED STATE: `measurements` is intentionally EMPTY -- every query is a cold start today, so q4_K (and every wired leaf) resolves via the prior. An offline-profile harness on `ssh rvv` fills a row ONLY after the candidate compiles, runs (micro / llama-bench), and PASSES the byte-exact gate for that instance.

key_semantics.declared_instance_hash: SHA-256 (lowercase hex) of the EXPANDED normalized capability fact set -- the SAME support::computeDeclaredInstanceHash the [D-4](1) exec / schedule attribution sinks compute (one helper, one hash). Portable across symbol renames; profile-vs-explicit-list declarations hash equal.
key_semantics.kernel: the decode_model (the SP4 tiling leaf identity), e.g. "q4_K". NOTE the SELECTION keys on the bottleneck SHAPE (fold_model), NEVER this format name; `kernel` is only the measurement-row identity, not a dispatch key.

value_shape.measured_ns: median wall-clock ns of the byte-exact-gated micro/bench run (number, optional if vs_generic_ratio is given).
value_shape.vs_generic_ratio: speedup vs the scalar/naive-autovec baseline (number, optional).

board_identity.vreg_count: architectural vector register count (32 for rvv1.0).
board_identity.march: the -march the measurement was taken under (e.g. "rv64gcv").

value_shape.byte_exact_gate: "pass" -- a row is written ONLY past the byte-exact gate (fail-closed: an un-gated timing is never cached).
value_shape.cv: coefficient of variation across samples (number, the noise floor).
value_shape.ts: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the measurement.

$meta.fail_closed_revalidate: The selector discards a cached winner that is no longer feasible under the current capability facts (Stage-1 legality re-check) and falls back to the prior -- a stale cache never forces an infeasible variant.
